name: The Abandoned House
description: The opening location. Search it for Metal Plates and Rope, take the Axe, tune the radio, then follow the caller's directions west to the Trading Post. Do not overload the first trip; fuel and hull matter more than one extra barrel.

name: Betsy and Sons
description: Gill and Bozur's shop and the quest hub of the opening act. Accept fishing contracts here, buy the Carburetor after the Harpooner delivery, sell catches, and use the Grinder, Thresher, Fuel Larva and workbench. The Bunkhouse key comes from the opening conversation.

name: The Bunkhouse
description: Malcolm's lodging. Carry the chest from the pier, place it inside, patch the hole in the wall and sleep. Collect the Simple Rod before leaving; the first fishing contract cannot be completed without it.

name: The Dry Dock
description: John the Fifth's workshop. Repair the fuse box with a Cable, flip the Power Switch, raise the boat on the lift, blast the polyps off with the Water Cannon and patch hull sections with Bug Slime. Hull Protection and the Upgraded Engine are crafted and installed here.

name: Angler's Island
description: A coral-covered island close to the Trading Post — visible from the lodging house balcony. Break the coral growths with the Axe for Coral Fibers, and check the growths again on later trips.

name: Peaceful Fishing Grounds
description: The marked peaceful spot where the three-Softgrazer contract is completed. Equip Wind-Up Tin, cast into the active zone and let the fish take the bait before pulling. Process the catch at the Thresher for Chromatic Scales.

name: Predator Splash Zone
description: Predators reveal themselves through splash zones on the surface. Cast Rainbow Fin into the disturbance and retrieve slowly enough for the fish to follow. Three Harpooners unlock the Carburetor at Betsy and Sons.

name: The Salvage Fields
description: Wreck-strewn water rich in floating containers. Use the Hook Gun on barrels and metal containers for Metal Plates, Gears and other salvage. Watch the fuel gauge on the way out and back.

name: The Throat
description: The gate out of the demo region. The generator needs fuel, the machinery needs a Thermal Coil, a Gear and two Buckets, the Water Pump needs a repair in place, and both water wheels must turn before the Gate Control opens the passage.
quests: Open the Gates of the Throat

name: The Blight Line
description: Where the Sea Blight thickens. Mutant fish such as Glowbug are recorded in the blighted backwater along the line. Approach with a repaired hull and a full tank.
